title: Are You There God? It's Me, Margaret
author: Judy Blume
summary: Eleven-year-old Margaret Simon moves from New York City to the suburbs of New Jersey. She talks to God about friends, puberty and religion, since her parents come from different faiths.
readIf: you want a gentle, honest, funny story about growing up and wondering about belief.
skipIf: you want plot-driven action or find dated 1970s details a distraction.
